## Developer Reference

[ADR-072](../../adr/adr-072-canon-publication-policy.qmd).

- **Source:** [`src/uiao/schemas/link-registry/link-registry.schema.json`](../../../src/uiao/schemas/link-registry/link-registry.schema.json)
- **Dialect:** `https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema`

## Description

Constrains src/uiao/canon/link-registry.yaml (UIAO_145, ADR-132 Phase 1). A Link is the governed record of one interconnection between the org and one outside party: interface + agreement artifact + regime overlay. The registry holds metadata about exchanges, never exchanged payload data, and performs no entity resolution (ADR-132 D1 boundaries).

## Structure

Top level: `schema-version`, `updated`, and `links` — an array of Link
objects. Each Link carries:

| Field | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `id`, `name` | Stable kebab-case identifier; display name |
| `counterparty.name` / `counterparty.class` | The outside party and its taxonomy class (`federal-agency`, `federal-branch`, `state`, `local`, `tribal`, `regulated-commercial`, `general-commercial`, `consortium`, `public`) |
| `direction` | `inbound` / `outbound` / `bidirectional` |
| `ssot-stance` | `we-are-source` / `they-are-source` / `contended` — wired to the ADR-074 contention drift class |
| `status` | `proposed` / `active` / `retired` |
| `interface.*` | Transport, identity binding, description |
| `agreement.*` | Artifact class (`isa`/`mou`/`interagency-mou`/`cma`/`baa`/`dua`/`contract`/`consortium-membership`/`unrecorded`), location, provenance anchoring, review cadence, next review date |
| `regime-overlays` | Boundary-attached regimes riding the link, each satisfied by a vertical adapter pack |
| `controls` | Controls the link evidences (CA-3, CA-9, SA-9, AC-20, …) |
| `authorized-by` | Repo-relative ADR/spec paths authorizing the interconnection (walker-verified) |

Object model authority:
[`UIAO_145`](https://github.com/WhalerMike/uiao/blob/main/src/uiao/canon/specs/UIAO_145_link-object-class.md);
doctrine: [ADR-132](../../adr/adr-132-orglink-link-object-class.qmd),
elevation: [ADR-134](../../adr/adr-134-orglink-pillar-elevation.qmd).
